PM Modi Honors Sir M. Visvesvaraya on Engineers' Day

Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tribute to Sir M. Visvesvaraya on the occasion of National Engineers' Day. He hailed engineers as 'Karmayogis' and acknowledged their significant contributions. The Prime Minister emphasized the role of engineers in nation-building and development.
